title: The AWS account the connection reaches

accountId.description: sts get-caller-identity Account, the root's canonical key

callerArn.description: The principal the credential runs as (sts get-caller-identity Arn)

homeRegion.description: The region passed as --region to the account-level calls: the defaultRegion setting (default us-east-1)

regionsRead.description: Regions tried, whether or not their functions could be listed

regionsComplete.description: true when the regions are every region the account has enabled (ec2 describe-regions); false when the regions setting narrowed them
